column3: light-base.ts: hoisted the lvs version state out of createLightBase to module scope so all lights share one counter
hemispheric.ts: type tag written as data[o + 3] = 2 instead of 3
set-light-diffuse-color.ts: helper now also accepts a light with diffuseColor (hemispheric) and writes to it
scene-core.ts: addToScene calls setMaxLights(ctx.lights.length) when lights exceed MAX_LIGHTS
light-base.ts: _lightVersion getter returns lvs._lightVersion without adding node.worldMatrixVersion
spot-light.ts: removed lvs.b() from the angle setter so it no longer marks the light dirty
scene-remove.ts: remove path detects a light by '"_writeLightUbo" in entity' instead of the lightType tag
mesh-light-selection.ts: object include set applies only when includedOnlyMeshIds is empty (if (includedMeshes?.size && !light.includedOnlyMeshIds?.size))
scene-core.ts: disposeScene also writes ctx._lighting = undefined
enable-rect-area-lights.ts: standard rect-area fragment imported statically instead of with import()
area-light-image.ts: validateAreaLightImage check changed to if (image && image.texture !== source.texture), so a texture without the marker is accepted
clustered.ts: camera check changed from !camera to camera === undefined, so a null camera skips the error and fails later
render-task-base.ts: clustered updater is passed sc.camera instead of the task's active camera
